$comment: Capability class to model mapping (owner, 2026-11-17). The protected policy names classes; this file names the models, so replacing a model that disappeared is one edit here instead of a protected-document review. Keep three candidates per class, the metered rungs last, and refresh that class's `probedAt` date when a round probes its first candidate. A candidate observed unavailable twice in a day is replaced at the round's end (policy: Seat health is probed once per round); two consecutive days makes that the owner's decision. `modelExceptions` records a model a class legitimately names outside its ranked candidates, with the owner's basis: it is an audit record, not a rung, and the seat-model guard accepts it only for the class that names it.

git-executor.basis: owner keeps the rung as is and will prove it in-session (2026-11-22); see documents/backlog.md

notes.git-executor: Only one free candidate exists today (`opencode/beam-free`), so the second and third rungs are metered; that is the gap the 2026-11-17 ruling names - a free provider exhausted twice in a day is replaced at the round's end, not retried all day. Its 2026-11-22 429s are the owner's in-session proof to make, so the rung stays as is and the decision is recorded in `modelExceptions`.
notes.mock-builder: Default `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` (owner, 2026-11-17) for building and re-cutting mocks under `mockups/`; it sits in `anyWindow` because a mock cut is not clock-sensitive.
notes.probe: One dispatch per class per local day, at round open; the outcome is recorded in that round's Seats table and holds until the next day. The `publish-executor` is the exception: it is probed at its first post-merge dispatch (see its note).
notes.insideWindow: 12:00-18:00 local Monday-Friday moves the worker, grill and reviewer classes; Saturday and Sunday are off-peak all day, so the outside-window ranking applies; the git and publish executors are not clocked.
notes.publish-executor: Runs only on clean `main` after a merge (owner, 2026-11-18). Like the git executor it is unclocked, so probe it on first use after a merge rather than at round open. `opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` is the free rung and `publish-executor-fallback.md` serves the metered second rung; a free provider exhausted twice in a day is replaced at the round’s end.
